name: Restaurant, café, bakery
settings: a top-down wooden table in a Kigali restaurant
a night venue terrace with warm lights
a counter with pizza boxes ready for delivery
a home kitchen with a pan of food steaming
an overhead plate on a tray with a hand pouring the sauce
offers: LUNCH TIME promo, Monday to Friday, 11 AM to 2 PM
cta: Order on {app} or call {phone}; the area (Kicukiro Sonatube, Kimironko).
longestRunning: Magic Chef Kigali runs one dish per video (7+ ads) with the same two delivery numbers; Best Burgers shows one burger, one price (PROMO FOR 5K) and two numbers for the whole clip; BestPilau's anniversary promo puts a price ladder (35K → 27K, 20K → 15K) in the caption over a plain overhead plate.

name: Phone and electronics shop
settings: the shop counter with boxed phones and a wall of brand logos
a seller holding the phone in the shop
hands turning two phones to show front and back
a hand fanning four phones in front of the shop shelves
an overhead unboxing on a white table, hands only
offers: DM now before stock ends (only when stock is really limited)
cta: WhatsApp or call {phone}; the shop address and room number (Makuza Peace Plaza, Room 35).
longestRunning: Real staff, real stock and the shop address with a landmark (Makuza Peace Plaza, Room 35) build trust where phone scams are common; a seller behind the counter with a lower-third price bar and two numbers (Elohome, 8 ads live); a model badge ('iPhone 18pro and 18pro max are available On discount', 'IPHONE 13 PRO 256GB').

name: Salon, barber, nails, beauty
settings: the salon chair with a ring light
close-ups of hands braiding
a 2x2 grid of nail colours
the salon sign and mirrors
a close-up of a real treatment in soft light, the landmark address baked in
offers: special offer any style {price} (inclusive of braids & free wash)
cta: Book on WhatsApp {phone}; the street (Roysambu, Lumumba Drive style).
longestRunning: SPOT SALON (Nairobi) ran one flat price including a free wash for 982 days; in Kigali, Prime Wellness shows a real massage with 'Available 24/7' and 'Next to DELIGHT HOTEL' on screen; Lou Aesthetic opens on a question card ('Ready to see your skin exactly how it used to be?'). Round 3 (10 Kigali spa, nail, wig and brow ads, all young): a real treatment close-up with the hours and a landmark address burned in, a black-and-gold offer card ('MICROBLADING OFFER 20K'), the number printed under the video.
gaps: Kigali salon ads are young (at most 24 days live) and few show a price; the long-running examples are Nairobi's.

name: Fashion, boutique, shoes, bags
settings: a real wearer outdoors in daylight
a clothes rack in the boutique
a mannequin showing the detail
boxes of new arrivals being opened
one sneaker turned 360 degrees in one hand outdoors
cta: Send a WhatsApp message {phone}; the shop area.
longestRunning: A 5 s loop of one model walking (Modesees, 353 days) and four colours in 10 s on a real wearer (NILA BABY SHOP, 439 days) are enough; Trendy.Wear.Kigali shows one feature (a breastfeeding opening) for the whole clip with the price in the caption. Kigali sneaker sellers (9 round-3 ads) show one pair in a hand or being laced, a model label on screen ('Hoka Clifton 9'), and put the sizes and 'Call&Whatsapp' in the caption; almost none shows the price in the video.

name: Real estate (sale and rent)
settings: the gate and the front of the house at golden hour
a smooth gimbal walk-through of the living room, kitchen and bedrooms
the plot-size sign and the parking
the view from the terrace over the Kigali hills
the agent introduces the house in a selfie, then a gimbal walk-through
a site plan laid over the roadside for plots
cta: WhatsApp {phone}; district, sector and street (Kicukiro, Kanombe, Kabeza); the property ID.
longestRunning: Hills Props and IBRA open on a location stack and a yellow price box ('Ibibanza byiza Masaka inyuma Ya Gare Bigurishwa / Price: 16M'); Bosco shows '350M RWF' top-right from second 3 with a WhatsApp overlay; captions are Kinyarwanda checklists (rooms, plot size, water and power, title).
gaps: The highest-liked tours are American luxury homes; Kigali property ads are 30 to 90 s Facebook ads, mostly young (days to weeks).

name: School, training, courses
settings: a teacher in uniform pointing at the lesson
a classroom with students working
a notepad list filled from frame 0
students in matching overalls working on a car in the real workshop
cta: WhatsApp {phone} to register; the campus area.
longestRunning: Action College Rwanda shows students doing the work in the real workshop, with three branch numbers in the lower third; British English Language Institute (157 days) lists the camp's specifics in the caption; Fluently's 'Don't say / Say' lesson is a before/after in one frame.
gaps: Two Rwandan school ads now (one only read as text); no price is shown by any of them.

name: Transport and travel (car hire, cars, tours, travel agencies)
settings: the real fleet parked in the compound
a car driving on a Kigali road
the interior and the boot opened
a walk-around of the vehicle in the showroom with the website bar on screen
cta: WhatsApp / Call {phone}, burned in from second 1 to the end.
longestRunning: homeofhybrid (Kigali, 468 days) runs raw phone footage of the cars with one word sticker per beat and a permanent yellow phone bar; Judith Safaris (565 days, the longest-running Rwandan ad found) is a corporate interview with a name card and subtitles; travel agencies use a poster first frame with a schedule and a phone bar ('HIKE MOUNT JALI … HIKING EVERY DAY'), and a car dealer floats spec labels over a walk-around ('Engine size 3,604 cc').
gaps: Car hire and travel together (12 Rwandan ads); few show a price.

name: Clinic, pharmacy, health
settings: the doctor in a white coat in the real consulting room
the clinic front and its sign
the reception desk
a white question card, then a soft macro of the treated area
cta: Call or WhatsApp {phone} (two numbers); the address with a landmark (Gishushu, Lemigo Hotel).
longestRunning: Derma Skin Clinic Rwanda runs 15+ variants since March 2026: a named doctor explains one condition in 60 s, boxed captions, the address and two numbers in every caption, the WhatsApp button; English and Kinyarwanda versions. It is the advertiser with the most live ads among the long runners (17 seen).
gaps: Health claims and before/after are restricted: education and booking only.

name: Events, venues, hotels, gifts
settings: the hall dressed and lit before guests arrive
a terrace with tables set
a grid of four gift options
a poster first frame, then 3 or 4 night clips of the lounge
offers: Free hall and free decoration, you only pay for food and drink
longestRunning: One Click Hotel offers the hall and decoration free (pay only food and drink); Élevée Lounge's 'FRIDAY UNLOCKED / Buy 4, get 5' poster names the landmark ('opposite IPRC traffic lights') and runs every Friday; flowerbar_zanzibar's 5 s gift grid ran 652 days. Among the long runners, a Kigali residence states 'from 20,000 RWF a night' with a WhatsApp button (124 days).
gaps: The thinnest sector: 6 event and venue rows (One Click Hotel's video did not load); hotels and residences add 2 more.

name: Services (cleaning, repair, delivery, printing, garage)
settings: the team at work on site
the workshop with the tools
the finished job held still
a technician holding the router at the client's door
the finished railing or staircase held still
cta: Call or WhatsApp {phone}; the areas served.
longestRunning: Piramie 4G+ pins '20 Mbps | 20K / month' on every frame and ran 6 variants in 11 days; Royal Aluminium and Website Design Rwanda open on a loss or pain line ('Old railing rusting?', 'STOP LOSING CUSTOMERS ONLINE!') and a free quote; a renovation time-lapse got 415.7K likes on TikTok. Long-running Rwandan service ads (tax, auto service, website design, travel) run 45 to 90 s with an offer of a visit, a consultation or a discount instead of a price.

name: Shop (general retail, cosmetics, kitchenware, wholesale)
settings: a tidy shop counter in a Kigali shop
a wall of stock with a hand holding one item
the shop floor with a greeting assistant
boxes of new stock
the product doing its job in a plain room, all the facts in one text block at the top
cta: WhatsApp {phone}; the shop's building and room number.
longestRunning: In Kigali, EHA 250, Titanium Smart Life and Elohome keep the price and the number on screen from frame 0 (a top text block or a lower-third bar); the cash-on-delivery sellers (Kenlina-B, Ugalina, TnzStore) ran one template for up to 24 months with 'Free delivery, pay after delivery'; Bahnasawi writes the offer in Kinyarwanda capitals over the furniture.
